title: reg.exe queries HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Disk\Enum (VM / hardware discovery)
source: ML-style review of Wazuh archives.json (events with no corresponding alerts.json entry)
description: reg.exe (child of `cmd.exe /c systeminfo & reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Disk\Enum`) reads the Disk\Enum key, which holds the disk hardware ID (VMware/Virtual) – a well known sandbox / VM-detection and system discovery trick. Wazuh alerted on the parent cmd.exe and on systeminfo.exe, but the reg.exe process creation itself was not alerted.
why_wazuh_missed: No Wazuh rule keyed on reg.exe 'query' of hardware-identification keys; only generic cmd.exe-started-by-powershell (92052) fired on the parent.
detection_hints_for_rule: Sysmon EID 1: image endswith \reg.exe AND commandLine matches (?i)query\s+HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\Disk\\Enum
parentCommandLine contains 'systeminfo' (chained discovery in a single cmd /c)
